title: 21V Cordless Impact Drill, Electric Screwdriver, Electric Hammer Drill, Mini Cordless Hand Drill, Lithium-ion Battery Power Tools
body_html:
3-in-1 Cordless Impact Drill (Brushless), 21V Cordless Screwdriver with Tool Case and Two Batteries

【2 x 1500mAh Batteries】The 1.5Ah batteries extend runtime. Higher battery capacity means higher efficiency and longer lifespan: approximately 300 screws can be driven in at once, 30 holes drilled in metal, and 35 holes drilled in a wall.

【10mm Self-Locking Spindle】Our 10mm self-locking spindle ensures a secure hold even with larger diameter screws. It also allows you to drill larger holes and tackle more challenging tasks.

21V, Two Speeds: Speeds of 0 to 700 RPM and 0 to 1500 RPM make tightening and loosening screws easy. Lower speeds allow for precise tightening, while higher speeds easily reach deeper threads. Maximum torque is 32 Nm.

【Practical and Economical】Built-in LED light provides optimal illumination for dimly lit work areas. Includes 30 accessories. Applications:

Drilling mode is suitable for drilling holes in materials such as wood, plastic, and metal.
